text:
Hannah C.: Heads-up — onboarding flow in sample-app broke because of an SDK vs REST parameter/feature mismatch for batched upserts. REST supports per-item dedupe via `dedupe_key` and per-item metadata, but the JS SDK's bulk helper strips `dedupeKey` on items and sends a top-level param named `dedupe` (boolean) instead. Weird casing + param-location drift.

Hannah C.: REST repro that works:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/upsert_bulk \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"open-embedding-1\",\"items\":[{\"text\":\"a\",\"dedupe_key\":\"row-123\",\"meta\":{\"src\":\"csv\"}},{\"text\":\"b\",\"dedupe_key\":\"row-124\",\"meta\":{\"src\":\"csv\"}}]}'
```

Hannah C.: Using SDK (js v0.9.4) we call `client.embeddings.upsertBulk({ model, items })` but the server logs show body: `{"items":[{"text":"a","meta":{"src":"csv"}},{"text":"b","meta":{"src":"csv"}}],"dedupe":true}` — dedupe_key gone, and server rejects with `422 missing dedupe_key for item` when dedupe is enabled. Also noticed SDK silently retries on 429 ignoring `Retry-After`, and because dedupe_key is missing we end up writing duplicates when the retry hits.

Ethan M.: Yikes. So two separate problems: (1) param/field parity — SDK should preserve per-item keys like `dedupe_key` and not rename/move them; (2) retry semantics — SDK needs to honor `Retry-After` and surface hooks or let callers opt out. Which SDK file is doing the rewrite?

Yara P.: Likely the high-level `normalizeItems` helper introduced when we added a convenience `dedupe: true` top-level option. It probably flattens per-item dedupe into a global boolean. That's a regression from our REST contract. I'll grep the JS client.

Infra Bot: rate-limiter: api_key=* returned 429 at 1801234575, Retry-After: 7s

Hannah C.: For onboarding I patched the sample-app to call the REST endpoint directly and preserved dedupe_key on each row. But this blocks the out-of-the-box onboarding experience so marking as blocker for sample-app.

Ethan M.: Plan: (1) revert/adjust the `dedupe` convenience to preserve per-item `dedupe_key` when items include that field; (2) add an explicit `items[].dedupe_key` param to SDK types and docs; (3) change retry middleware to parse and honor `Retry-After` and expose a `retryCallback` so apps can inspect retries (and optionally cancel); (4) add e2e that uploads two items with dedupe_key and simulates a 429 to assert we don't duplicate.

Yara P.: I'll open a PR for the JS client with the serializer fix and a small test. We should also add a compatibility note in changelog so users know about deprecating the top-level boolean in favor of per-item keys.

Doc Ops: Added onboarding note: "If you rely on per-item dedup keys, use REST bulk endpoint until SDK patch" to quickstart. Issue redwood/sdk#1301 created and linked to this thread.

Hannah C.: Thanks — moving sample-app back to REST for now. Will watch the PR and revert once SDK release includes the serializer + retry fix. :thumbsup:
